title: Summer's coldest night is 0 °C
hints: Winter data works and summer data doesn't. What do all the summer readings have in common? Compare them with the value `coldest` starts at.
`coldest` starts at 0, which isn't one of the readings. If every reading is above 0, none of them is ever colder than the starting value, so 0 comes back.
Start from a real reading instead: `int coldest = readings[0];`.
